originals.ko: 나는 다음에 무엇이 올지 절대 알지 않을 거야
originals.why: Moved here from another seed. The Welsh is still natural: 'fydda i byth yn gwybod beth ddaw nesa’' correctly pairs byth with the future form fydda i, and it uses the LEGO in the same sense this course teaches.

originals.ko: 내일 밤 다음에 무엇이 오든, 나는 알아내고 싶지 않아
다음에 무엇이 오든, 나는 괜찮을 거라고 확신해

topups.why: '그러면' could also be said as felly in Welsh, so the prompt allows two answers where only wedyn is meant.
Asking what comes next 'after the meal' is an odd, unnatural combination.
A bare 'to find out … now' fragment is unnatural, and the Korean dictionary form reads badly as a prompt.
It is a reasonable line, but the three USE top-ups are already filled with stronger ones. Also, the present-tense ddaw sits awkwardly with the past-tense oeddan.
'mae o i fod yn her' is unidiomatic here, and '원래 도전인 거야' is a strained Korean equivalent.
'Not finding out until the end of the second half' is a contrived meaning, and the Korean '끝까지' does not clearly match tan ddiwedd ('until the end').
